scope: Seven finite operation families; no runtime, media, profile admission or renewed adoption gate.

duties.requirement: Original immutable bytes/values, full content identities, input view, assumptions, coverage and every mutable copy source.
Exact occurrences/insertion locations and destinations; expected-old/absent state, collision and conflict policy.
Actual physical objects, parents, path/alias/link and candidate bindings; deterministic continuing profile guards.
Relevant attributes, ownership/access, times, streams, links, pre/post conditions and checkpoint/refusal policy.
Typed old/new values, transformations, implicit updates, no-op and protected payload/interpretation/unknown/reference/checksum effects.
Exact losses and acknowledgements, conflict choice, residual/uninspectable scope; no inferred consent.
Schema/model/reader/registry/conversion/mapping/capability/policy and profile revisions, fresh trusted revalidation and visible replanning.
Actual admitted storage profile, checked candidate, expected destination, guards and exact persistence acknowledgements.
Original/absent state, owned artifacts and identities, private bounded retention/custody and fresh recovery conditions.
Units, dependencies, pairs, original-snapshot/frozen-copy evaluation, guard/publication order, cancel and partial/resume behavior.
Fresh separate caller application, inert strict bounded imports and trusted current admission; no executable callbacks.

duties.P-READ: Complete source length/SHA-256 and exact original ASCII20 occurrence; #77 captures actual stable-stream content, not live object custody.
duties.P-WRITE: Unique existing CMT2 Exif 36867 allocation/path/byte order plus intended ASCII20; proposed require-absent new output only.
duties.P-IDENTITY: Unresolved execution binding: locator/digest are not object, parent, alias or live guard identities.
duties.P-PROPERTY: Only declared OD-11 private-owner new-output policy; actual current properties/checkpoints remain unresolved.
duties.P-EFFECT: Exact Gregorian ASCII20 intent and complement declaration; equal-byte no-op intent. No implicit transform; opaque dependencies remain refused.
duties.P-LOSS: No requested representation/zone loss or mapping; future observed coupled effects must refuse or be explicitly bound, never silently broadened.
duties.P-REVISION: Existing exact schema and model/reader/admission/registry/capability/conversion/policy revisions; import and #77 revalidation reject staleness.
duties.P-PUBLICATION: Profile is literally unavailable-production; no candidate publication or acknowledgement is implemented by this protocol.
duties.P-RECOVERY: Literal no-mutation-or-recovery-authority; no staging, backup, prune, replay or cleanup effect.
duties.P-ORDER: One source/occurrence/new output; no mutable copy sources, pairs or ordering choices in this v1.
duties.P-AUTHORITY: Separate-caller-required; existing importer never authorizes any execution, even with matching content.

duties.P-READ: Reuse saved exact occurrence/content intent through #78, refreshing trusted source and all dependency observations.
duties.P-WRITE: One existing date allocation into explicitly selected absent new CR3 output; no in-place or overwrite fallback.
duties.P-IDENTITY: Bind held original/candidate and resolved destination/parent/ancestors with continuous required byte/name guards.
duties.P-PROPERTY: OD-11 boundary checks and ordinary private owner-editable output; source properties unchanged, unsupported carry-through refuses.
duties.P-EFFECT: Actual reread candidate, exact old/new ASCII20, no-op and complete protected complement/interpretation/dependency proof; current RAW admission refuses.
duties.P-LOSS: No invented reduction of RAW semantics; any implicit coupled effect/loss must be exposed and independently admitted.
duties.P-REVISION: All inherited revisions plus actual #78 operation, admitted format/layout, storage/receipt and conversion rule revisions.
duties.P-PUBLICATION: Exact no-clobber profile and actual acknowledgements; disabled or unavailable storage/format refuses before effects.
duties.P-RECOVERY: Expected-absent output, owned bounded staging/receipts and explicit current custody/outcome recovery conditions.
duties.P-ORDER: One publication unit; cancellation and post-attempt recovery-required cannot be encoded as unchanged success.
duties.P-AUTHORITY: Fresh caller apply through existing #78 bridge, never a serialized authorization boolean or a second adoption gate.

duties.P-READ: Freeze RAW and existing XMP bytes/content identities; exact CMT2 primary/fraction/offset observations and complete selected coverage.
duties.P-WRITE: Existing singleton exif DateTimeOriginal expanded name/packet ordinal and lexical range; separate absent output, no insertion/empty-sidecar creation.
duties.P-IDENTITY: Bind both selected source objects and parents, derivative candidate and new destination; pairing observation alone is insufficient.
duties.P-PROPERTY: Documented private-owner new sidecar, source property observations and explicit unsupported property carry-through refusals.
duties.P-EFFECT: Original-snapshot mapping with exact source fractions/offsets, XML prefix/suffix preservation, semantic target reparse and whole-byte no-op.
duties.P-LOSS: Refuse differing destination by default; explicit keep or exact named replacement loss acknowledgements, never host-zone conversion.
duties.P-REVISION: All duties plus native reader, packet/parser, mapping r5-cmt2-original-to-xmp-exif-original/1 and derivative/profile rules.
duties.P-PUBLICATION: Admitted derivative plus guarded no-clobber storage/receipts remain required independently of in-memory success.
duties.P-RECOVERY: Both originals retained, expected-absent output, exact owned artifacts and bounded custody/recovery conditions.
duties.P-ORDER: Freeze both original values before derivative; one output unit, no implicit RAW update or chained overlay read.
duties.P-AUTHORITY: Separate explicit caller request and fresh actual rights/technical checks; research result and packet inspection grant no publication.

duties.P-READ: Both immutable original members plus all mutable copy sources; freeze mapping values/resources before dependent publication.
duties.P-WRITE: Exact RAW/XMP member effects and destinations/conflict choices from admitted #78/#85 adapters; explicit membership, no basename guess.
duties.P-IDENTITY: Actual physical member/destination/parent bindings, duplicate-target rejection and deterministic multi-member guards.
duties.P-PROPERTY: Per-member selected profile/property checkpoints; no inference that a new-output policy qualifies existing-target replacement.
duties.P-EFFECT: Per-member typed effects and protected dependencies, original-snapshot mapping and independent candidate validation.
duties.P-LOSS: Per-member explicit loss decisions and refused/skipped effects; pair agreement cannot be inferred from path association.
duties.P-REVISION: All member schema/model/mapping/admission/profile and shared executor/receipt revisions bound together.
duties.P-PUBLICATION: Separate qualified publication for each actual member; no cross-file atomicity or shared implied durable commit.
duties.P-RECOVERY: Per-member owned artifacts/current trusted receipts and fresh custody, preserving completed work without replay.
duties.P-ORDER: Explicit order/dependencies and per-unit committed/refused/pending/recovery-required state; receipt-bound resume never replays committed members.
duties.P-AUTHORITY: One explicit resolved caller request plus fresh member admission; an imported group or receipt cannot self-authorize.

duties.P-READ: Actual immutable selected sidecar and complete target inventory; lawful purpose/lineage and retained-artifact inventory remain distinct requirements.
duties.P-WRITE: Only R5P-026 sidecar.xmp aux OwnerName, exact document/ordinal/form/whole-property range; zero no-op, one deletion, multiple/unknown refuse.
duties.P-IDENTITY: Actual source/derivative/new destination object and parent identities with live byte/name guards; content labels grant no authority.
duties.P-PROPERTY: Private-owner output and source property checks, declared original/backup/report retention and supported property scope.
duties.P-EFFECT: Whole-property removal, exact lexical complement and target-only semantic deletion; all unrelated/protected data preserved.
duties.P-LOSS: Per-artifact removed/retained/residual/uninspectable scope, 31-selector/59-template denominator, originals/backups/previews and provenance refusal; no anonymity claim.
duties.P-REVISION: All duties plus catalog, removal contract, parser/mechanism, observer, known-provenance and exact rights/operation records.
duties.P-PUBLICATION: Actual admitted removal derivative and selected new-output profile required; contract vectors are not actual publication.
duties.P-RECOVERY: Target-bearing source/backups retained and reported; no silent deletion or secure erase, bounded private artifacts with current custody.
duties.P-ORDER: One selected output unit, complete request preflight; retained artifact audit is separate from requested removal count.
duties.P-AUTHORITY: Fresh caller request plus exact operation rights/technical admission; existing purpose-limited media grants cannot be broadened.

duties.P-READ: Actual owned retained original, properties and byte identity; separately bind later-edited current version, not stale original-path assumptions.
duties.P-WRITE: Explicit chosen restore destination and expected-absent or exact expected-old occupied state; preserve later version separately.
duties.P-IDENTITY: Fresh original/current/candidate/root/parent holds and trusted retained custody; arbitrary saved JSON is not imported authority.
duties.P-PROPERTY: Exact retained property completeness and destination profile; #108 canonical marker observations do not prove complete media/property restore.
duties.P-EFFECT: Copy original without consuming it, verify candidate and preserve later current; no implicit rollback or lost later edits.
duties.P-LOSS: Expose restoration effects/property limits and preserved later-version location; refuse unsupported loss or occupied overwrite.
duties.P-REVISION: All duties plus actual retention, restore, custody and expected-target/profile/receipt revisions.
duties.P-PUBLICATION: #108 fresh-name marker observation is bounded research; occupied #95 requires strict replacement, no fallback overwrite.
duties.P-RECOVERY: Fresh restore authorization, owned artifacts, original retention and current custody; no imported prune/replay/finalize authority.
duties.P-ORDER: Restore is a new planned unit, not automatic recovery; occupied replacement retains its distinct ordered preservation steps.
duties.P-AUTHORITY: Fresh explicit caller restore action after checks; #108 typed-owned fixture is not an external saved-context importer.

duties.P-READ: Finite two-member original read sets, every copy source and frozen values/resources; never accidentally read earlier edited member bytes.
duties.P-WRITE: Exact typed member operations/profiles, destinations and expected states; conflicts/duplicate physical targets refuse.
duties.P-IDENTITY: Deterministic physical guard order across originals/candidates/destinations/parents; recheck receipt-bound identities on resume.
duties.P-PROPERTY: Per-member properties and strict existing-target obligations; new-output OD-11 does not weaken replacement.
duties.P-EFFECT: Per-unit requested/implicit effects and protected regions; validate each candidate independently, no generic free-form effect graph.
duties.P-LOSS: Every member loss/conflict choice and partial outcome exposed; grouping grants no extra consent.
duties.P-REVISION: All member schema/model/rule/profile revisions plus group order, executor and receipt/finalization revisions.
duties.P-PUBLICATION: One file published at a time using qualified member profiles; no assumed atomic two-member namespace transaction.
duties.P-RECOVERY: Per-member original retention, trusted current receipts/custody and separate replacement finalization; never replay committed units.
duties.P-ORDER: Exact finite order/dependencies, committed/refused/pending/recovery-required outcomes and receipt-bound explicit resume, cancel/crash boundaries.
duties.P-AUTHORITY: Separate caller group request and fresh member eligibility; editable order/receipt/plan assertions grant no authority.

residuals.unmet: General set/delete, file-sourced values, raw/normalized conversion and implicit updates beyond one ASCII20 field.
Missing field/block creation, allocation/defaults and group creation; existing singleton replacement does not qualify insertion.
Replace, append, remove exact duplicate/index, explicit deduplication and sequence/bag shape.
Explicit path updates, whole replacement and recursive merge with sibling/unknown-namespace preservation.
Named language/x-default updates/deletion, whole-property deletion and unrelated-language preservation.
Shifts, AllDates sets, calendar/duration/zone assumptions, clock correction, track interpolation, geotag destinations and inverse lookup/export.
General immutable copy/context/redirection, all:all location identity, new-group creation and mapping/loss forms.
Ordinary/case-only rename, same-volume cycle, cross-volume move and paired path effects need exact typed bindings and order.
Occupied-name actual media restore, complete property backup and explicit finalized-backup prune remain distinct from #108 fresh-name markers.
General inspect/count/save/restore intent lifetime, conflicts and broader groups; imported values never carry execution authority.
Other RAW layouts, native GPS/serial/provenance removal, stored-preview mutations and general repair/validation remain unqualified.
